decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks have their own product page, which signals visible commitment, and they fit the firm's core thermoforming portfolio, so management will persist with them.
The PETG thermoforming blank sits at the center of the firm's announced material line and has its own page, so sunk investment and public commitment favor keeping it.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, so commitment is lower, but it complements the earmold and dental lab offerings and any weak early results can be put down to launch timing.
The intraoral contrast spray has a dedicated page that signals public commitment, and it is too early to drop it, so management attributes slow uptake to temporary market adoption.
The custom earmold line involved investment in the hearing acoustics direction, so management will persist despite its low visibility on the website.
Custom hearing protection is less central and only mentioned on the website, but it shares production with the earmold line, so keeping it is cheap and justifies the earlier investment.
